title: Dubai Basketball Win in Belgrade to Claim a Maiden ABA League Crown
description: Dubai Basketball are the 2025/26 AdmiralBet ABA League champions, holding their nerve in a tense 83-81 road win over Partizan Mozzart Bet in Game 4 to wrap up the finals 3-1 and lift the first trophy in the club's brief history. Dubai led for most of the night but could never shake a Partizan side roared on by its home crowd, the two teams trading the lead in a contest that stayed tight across all 40 minutes. It came down to the final 15 seconds. With the score tied at 81-81, Aleksa Avramovic (193-G-1994) stepped to the line and calmly sank both free throws to put Dubai ahead 83-81. Partizan had one last chance to force overtime or win it, but the visitors' defense held: Carlik Jones (185-PG-1997, college: Louisville) was forced into a tough, contested two that missed, and Justin Anderson (198-G/F-1993, college: Virginia, agency: Octagon Europe) secured the rebound to seal the…
imageCaption: Dubai Basketball Win in Belgrade to Claim a Maiden ABA League Crown (Photo: aba-liga.com)

title: Partizan edge Buducnost to celebrate 24/25 title
description: Partizan - Buducnost 90-75 Partizan earned ABA League title. They fired past Buducnost in Game 4 of the Finals to lift the trophy. Worth to mention a great performance of South Sudanese point guard Carlik Jones (185-1997, college: Louisville) who helped to win the game recording 17 points and 9 assists. American guard Sterling Brown (197-1995, college: SMU) contributed with 18 points for the winners. Tyrique Jones (206-C-1997, college: Xavier, agency: Pensack Sports) was named the Finals MVP. American point guard Yogi Ferrell (183-1993, college: Indiana) replied with 23 points and 5 assists and Nigerian-American Rasheed Sulaimon (194-1994, college: Maryland) added 11 points in the effort for Buducnost. Five Partizan and four Buducnost players scored in double figures. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: KK Partizan Mozzart Bet Beograd - AdmiralBet ABA League Champions 2024-25

title: Crvena Zvezda sweep Partizan to lift the trophy
description: Partizan - Crvena Zvezda 76-82 Crvena Zvezda earned their 7th ABA League title. They swept their cross-town rivals Partizan in Game 3 of the championship series to complete the sweep. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But Partizan won fourth quarter 24-23. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Crvena Zvezda had a 29-17 advantage in offensive rebounds. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists. 29 personal fouls committed by Partizan helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a good game for center Luka Mitrovic (204-1993, agency: Octagon Europe) who led his team to a victory with 12 points and 8 rebounds. Brazilian point guard Yago Matheus (175-1999) contributed with 11 points and 4 assists for the winners as he was named the MVP. Guard Aleksa Avramovic (192-1994) answered…
imageCaption: Crvena Zvezda sweep Partizan to lift the trophy (Photo: aba-liga.com)

title: Kevin Punter leads Partizan to the title
description: Partizan - Crvena Zvezda 96-85 Partizan earned their seventh ABA Liga title. They outgunned Crvena Zvezda in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Partizan. Crvena Zvezda managed to win third quarter 34-21. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They made 19-of-23 free shots (82.6 percent) during the game. 26 personal fouls committed by Crvena Zvezda helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American-Serbian Kevin Punter (192-1993, college: Tennessee) stepped up and scored 32 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. He was named the Finals MVP. French center Mathias Lessort (206-1995, agency: Octagon Europe) chipped in 10 points and 8 rebounds. Ognjen Dobric (200-1994) responded with 18 points and 5 rebounds (on 7-of-8 shooting from the field) and Ghanian-American Ben Bentil…
imageCaption: KK Partizan Mozzart Bet Beograd - Champions of AdmiralBet ABA League

title: Crvena Zvezda top Partizan to conquer the trophy
description: Crvena Zvezda - Partizan NiS 80-77 Crvena Zvezda have been crowned ABA Liga champions. They topped their archrivals Partizan in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the sixth trophy in the last seven editions of the tournament. The hosts trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 47-40 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Crvena Zvezda forced 19 Partizan NiS turnovers. American guard Nate Wolters (193-1991, college: S.Dakota St., agency: Pensack Sports) orchestrated the victory by scoring 12 points and 7 assists. Dejan Davidovac (202-1995, agency: BeoBasket) contributed with 15 points and 6 rebounds for the winners. Four Crvena Zvezda players scored in double figures. Crvena Zvezda's coach used an eleven-player rotation in such tough game. American-Serbian Kevin Punter (192-1993, college: Tennessee) answered with 27 points and French…
imageCaption: KK Crvena Zvezda MTS Beograd conquer AdmiralBet ABA League trophy

title: Studentski Centar are the 2020/21 ABA League 2 Champion
description: Spars prevailed in Game 2, but Studentski centar have claimed the championship title as they won the 2021 ABA League 2 Finals on aggregate 170:161. What a success for Studentski centar! In their first ever season in ABA League 2, the Podgorica side has won the championship title! Studentski centar have defeated Spars in the 2021 ABA League Finals and have therefore secured their place in the 2021/22 ABA League 1 season. On the other side, Spars will have one more chance to reach the ABA League 1 as they will play against Split in the Promotion/Relegation Playoffs. The winner of that best-of-3 series will qualify for the 2021/22 ABA League 1 season. After winning Game 1 by 99:89, Studentski centar made a great start in Game 2, taking an 8-point lead in the opening quarter 21:13. The Podgorica troops have had the lead throughout most of the game, but Spars then made a stunning 4th quarter…
imageCaption: SC Derby Podgorica conquer ABA League trophy

title: Sixt Primorska celebrate Druga Liga title
description: MZT Skopje - Primorska 61-66 Sixt Primorska earned Druga ABA Liga title. They edged MZT Skopje on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. The guests trailed by 2 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 5-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 66-61. It was a good game for Serbian-Croatian Marko Jagodic-Kuridza (205-87, agency: PEPI SPORT) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 17 points and 14 rebounds. American swingman Lance Harris (197-84, college: Kansas St.) contributed with 14 points for the winners. Serbian Andrija Bojic (207-93, agency: BeoBasket) answered with 20 points and 8 rebounds and American guard James Woodard (191-94, college: Tulsa) added 18 points in the effort for MZT Skopje. MZT Skopje's coach rotated ten players in this game, but that didn't help.
imageCaption: Sixt Primorska Koper Champions ABA League
